whatIs: Dark Mode Design is a hand-picked gallery of websites with dark mode. Each entry shows a screenshot and links to the original site; the listing is browsed page by page with a "Next" link.
It's a good fit when you need references of real dark interfaces, especially landing pages and product sites.
uses: Seeing how other sites handle contrast and hierarchy before designing your app's dark theme.
Collecting dark home page references to show a client a visual direction.
Submitting your own dark site to the gallery by writing to the contact email.
caveats: It has no search, filters or visible categories: you can only move forward page by page.
It shows only screenshots; to see the interaction you have to open the original site.
Some entries are sponsored, marked as such.
pricingNote: Free to browse, with no account.
idealFor: People looking for dark site references without filtering by category.
